in_sanskrit.name: Meva
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gentle Breeze
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Meva एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Meva means gentle breeze. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'meva,' which translates to wind. In Hindu mythology, Meva is also associated with the god Vayu, the lord of the winds.
